# tofukit_file (Resource)

File resource for tofukit - enables reusable file definitions across projects



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) File path with extension (e.g., 'README.md', 'src/main.go'). Must be filesystem-compliant across platforms.

### Optional

- `content` (String) Static content of the file (mutually exclusive with instructions)
- `description` (String) Description of what this file does
- `instructions` (Attributes List) Instructions for generating the file content (mutually exclusive with content) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instructions))
- `verifications` (Attributes List) Verification commands for this file (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verifications))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `link` (String) URI link to this resource for cross-referencing (e.g., tofukit://file/name)

<a id="nestedatt--instructions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instructions`

Required:

- `prompt` (String) LLM-facing instruction describing what to generate

Optional:

- `constraints` (List of String) Constraints that must be respected (what NOT to do)


<a id="nestedatt--verifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verifications`

Required:

- `command` (String) Command to run for verification

Optional:

- `expect` (String) Expected output or pattern
